comment: The whole module is monophonic. A send is written only while both that side's send and its return carry cables, PPD.cpp:51-54; with the send patched and the return empty, the repeat goes to the output as usual and nothing comes out of the send. The note lengths are worked out at PPD.cpp:117-132, where the 1/32 dotted entry is set from the 1/16 row, so dotted 1/32 gives the same time as dotted 1/16. The delay time is clamped at 10 seconds, PPD.cpp:164.
